content: Hey beautiful, I was thinking about you all day. How was your afternoon?
Hi! That's sweet. My day was ok, just work and then home. How are you doing?
I'm alright. Work's a bit crazy but knowing I can talk to you makes it all better. Have you eaten? Don't want you skipping meals on my watch
Haha, you're too sweet. I had some leftovers. What about you?
I grabbed a quick salad between meetings. I keep dreaming of us having dinner together soon... I wish I could fly you out here.
That would be amazing. Maybe someday.
Definitely. You deserve the world after what you've been through. You know, I'm always here for you. I'm glad we found each other.
That means a lot. I feel like I can trust you. It's been a hard year for me.
You can trust me, truly. And I always want to support you, just like you support me.
Thank you, that's so nice. I haven't felt this close to someone in a while.

I feel the same way. Actually, I need to be honest with you. Something's come up and I'm a bit embarrassed to ask, but I'm in a tough spot right now. My investment account's been temporarily frozen due to a random audit, and I can't access my funds for a few days.
Oh no, that sounds stressful. What do you need to do?

I just need to cover an urgent hospital bill for my mom. It's $1,200 and the hospital only accepts payment through Zelle or Cash App. I'd pay you back in two days, I promise. Could you help me out? You're the only one I trust with this.
That's a lot... I want to help, but I'm nervous.

I completely understand, and I'd never put you in a bad position. I'll send you the full amount back as soon as my account is cleared. If it's easier, you could send just $600 now and the rest later. Zelle is the safest and most direct, do you have it?
I think I have Zelle. What do I need to do?
Just open your bank app and look for the Zelle option. I'll give you my mom's email address to send it to. And don't worry, I'll walk you through it step by step.
Okay, I found Zelle in my app. What's the email?
Thank you so much. The email is lucymorgan.medical@gmail.com. Can you send $600 for now? I'll confirm when it arrives.
Alright, I'm entering it now. Do you need my bank info or anything else?
No need for your bank info, just confirm the payment goes through. If it asks for a reason, just say 'family support' to avoid any delays.
Sent! Let me know if you get it. I really hope this helps your mom.
You're incredible, thank you. She means everything to me. As soon as my funds are released, I'll send it back, plus something extra, you deserve it.
You don't have to. I just care about you.
That's why you're so special to me. By the way, could you text me a screenshot of the confirmation? Just so I can check with the hospital.
Sure, I'll send it now.
Perfect, you're amazing. I'm honestly so grateful to have you in my life.
